submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE transparent RGBA game animation frame run SW 3. Image1 exact edit target. Images2–3 adjacent shoes' heading references ONLY; never copy their poses. Image4 approved painting style only, never reproduce UI.
Repaint ONLY the anatomical RIGHT grounded boot at bottom center-left; the other LEFT knee is raised, below the ankle, with one small correction of perspective. Its toe currently points too directly screen-down at the viewer. Turn the shoe's long axis modestly toward screen LOWER LEFT, matching the body's SW travel direction and adjacent references. Rounded toe / front sole lower-left, heel behind at upper-right. Preserve shoe width and short natural length. NOT a long horizontal sideways W shoe. Keep the exact ankle entry point, heel/sole ground contact location, knee/hip positions, leg spacing and present weight-bearing body-passing phase. Do not move the leg or body.
Keep the entire target pose and all other details visually unchanged: raised leg/boot, upper body, head, face, hair, outfit, bow, fingers, scale, camera, position and transparent square canvas. Anatomical LEFT hand long bamboo bow; RIGHT empty hand; RIGHT-shoulder quiver. Bright clean rounded detailed hand-painted ivory jade-green warm-gold chibi finish. No crop/recenter, no bbox scale, no lowest-foot alignment, no mirrored/interpolated/copied frame, no ground/background/shadow/text/grid/particles. True transparency.
